title: The study of the therapeutic effect and preliminary mechanism of EGCG on recurrent aphthous ulcer.
authors: You, XueDi; Shi, JunXing; Ren, ZhaoXu; Wang, Li; Zhao, WanHong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究EGCG对复发性口腔溃疡的促愈合作用及TLR4/NF-κB通路机制，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: To investigate the pro-healing effect of epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) on mucosal wounds of recurrent aphthous ulcer (RAU) mice and its molecular mechanism. The RAU mouse model was created using chemical cauterization, and ulcerated tissue was collected to observe morphological changes. Network pharmacology identified potential targets and mechanisms. TNF-alpha and IL-6 levels in ulcer tissues were measured using IHC and ELISA. Western Blotting and RT-qPCR assessed protein and RNA expressions of TLR4, MYD88, NF-kappaB, and related factors. A CCK8 assay evaluated the effect of drug concentration on cell activity. Finally, molecular docking and CETSA confirmed the association between EGCG and key target molecules. EGCG has been proven to accelerate the healing of ulcers in ICR mice. Meanwhile, EGCG improved the pathologic morphology of the oral mucosa in mice. A network pharmacological analysis of EGCG's impact on RAU may be associated with the Toll-like receptor signaling pathway. Simultaneously, the levels of TNF-alpha, IL-6, and the expressions of TLR4, MyD88, p-IKB-alpha, and p-NF-kappaBP65/NF-kappaB P65, NF-kappaB 1 were decreased. The level of IKB-alpha was elevated, Showing dose dependence. The EGCG-H group showed better results than the positive control group; EGCG was tightly bound to TLR4 and NF-kappaB p65 target proteins. In conclusion, EGCG promotes the healing of oral ulcers in RAU mice and increases collagen fiber volume fraction in ulcerated skin tissue. The mechanism may be associated with reducing TNF-alpha and IL-6 expression levels and inhibiting the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 为探讨表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯（EGCG）对复发性阿弗他溃疡（RAU）小鼠黏膜创面的促愈合作用及其分子机制。采用化学烧灼法建立RAU小鼠模型，收集溃疡组织观察形态学变化。网络药理学确定潜在靶点和机制。使用IHC和ELISA检测溃疡组织中TNF-α和IL-6水平。Western Blotting和RT-qPCR评估TLR4、MYD88、NF-κB及相关因子的蛋白质和RNA表达。CCK8实验评估药物浓度对细胞活性的影响。最后，分子对接和CETSA确认EGCG与关键靶分子之间的关联。EGCG已被证明能加速ICR小鼠溃疡愈合。同时，EGCG改善了小鼠口腔黏膜的病理形态。EGCG对RAU影响的网络药理学分析可能与Toll样受体信号通路相关。同时，TNF-α、IL-6水平以及TLR4、MyD88、p-IKB-α和p-NF-κB P65/NF-κB P65、NF-κB 1的表达均降低。IKB-α水平升高，呈剂量依赖性。EGCG-H组结果优于阳性对照组；EGCG与TLR4和NF-κB p65靶蛋白紧密结合。总之，EGCG促进RAU小鼠口腔溃疡愈合，并增加溃疡皮肤组织中胶原纤维体积分数。其机制可能与降低TNF-α和IL-6表达水平及抑制TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB信号通路有关。
